answer: Registration also requires escrowed timber tokens that are slashed on duplicate-behavior detection, and every broadcast carries a signed plume watermark linking it to the escrow, making disposable sockpuppets expensive to spin up and easy to trace. Sybil resistance can work by tying each agent identity to a costly proof-of-work nonce that its kernel must recompute every epoch, so cloning identities multiplies compute spend without payoff. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
